attention_timing_rule: Attention through month t may later be related only to outcomes at t+1; the alias manifest itself contains no outcomes.
collision_rule: If the selected alias collides across different security_keys during overlapping intervals, escalate all colliding rows to normalized full authoritative company names. Any remaining overlapping collision blocks the manifest.
display_equivalence_rule: When two authoritative names differ under Policy-V2 legal-core tokenization but their compact alphanumeric legal cores are identical, the difference is classified as deterministic punctuation/token-spacing presentation only. For the final alias interval, use the independently resolved authoritative source spelling. No fuzzy, substring, edit-distance, or semantic matching is permitted.
full_history_authorization: Full 2021-2025 GDELT extraction remains blocked until the alias manifest passes its integrity audit and a separate coverage/missingness gate is frozen.
high_ambiguity_rule: HIGH structural ambiguity, ticker-like exact issuer names, aliases shorter than four characters, and legal-core aliases equal to any historical ticker must use the normalized full authoritative company name instead of the core.
membership_rule: Alias intervals are clipped to canonical S&P 500 membership intervals.
outcome_leakage_rule: No returns, momentum, Winner labels, commonality factors, or H3 outcomes may be read while constructing or auditing aliases.
policy_revision_note: V3 incorporates the all-transition preflight result. Among 26 in-sample transition securities, 23 matched Policy V2 exactly, one (CPB) was a punctuation/token-spacing equivalent, and two (FBHS, PENN) were expected post-rename differences because Stage 3I membership names are pre-transition anchors. No sequential transition-chain nonmatch was found.
prewindow_public_rebrand_rule: If the public identity transition occurred before 2021-01-01, the post-transition public name is used from the sample start even if a later legal-name finalization occurs inside the sample.
stable_name_source_precedence: Stage 3I official membership company name for no-NPORT identities
Latest in-membership SEC NPORT holding name
Canonical project company name as final fallback
strict_alias_rule: Construct a conservative legal-core alias by normalizing case, punctuation, ampersands, leading THE, provider-style trailing /THE display notation, security-class labels, jurisdiction labels, and trailing legal forms only. Semantic words are retained.
terminal_state_validation_rule: If an authoritative in-membership name transition exists, a static membership company name is treated as the pre-transition identity anchor, not as the terminal post-transition company name. The static membership name must align with the first transition old-name state. The terminal post-transition state is determined by the authoritative event chain.
ticker_rule: Bare stock tickers are prohibited as production attention aliases.
transition_boundary_rule: Use authoritative public/trading effective date when available; otherwise use authoritative legal effective date.
transition_month_rule: No month-wide old/new overlap. The old alias is valid through the calendar day before the effective public boundary and the new alias is valid beginning on the effective boundary.
variant_rule: No suffix-stripped broad variants, ticker variants, or manually broadened synonyms are included in the primary production alias manifest.
